plan_item: 77.44.7.B — Rich Text selected-link URL and internal-page picker lifecycle
finding: Selecting an existing Rich Text link updated its target control but left the URL field and internal-page picker stale. Manual URL edits could also leave an unrelated internal-page option selected.
change: The Rich Text selection bridge now reads the selected runs' shared href. It hydrates one URL, clears plain-text selections, and shows a mixed placeholder when selected runs do not share a destination.

Moving focus from a selected link to Inspector controls preserves a URL being edited. The shared page picker now follows URL input and clears an obsolete page choice; choosing a published page uses its published slug.
Updated cache-bust versions across the affected Editor entry point and transitive modules so browsers load the released Inspector and shared control code.
